image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a brown butterfly resting on dry grass and straw. The butterfly's wings are spread open, displaying a uniform dark brown color with distinct rows of small, circular eyespots (ocelli) on both the forewings and hindwings. The body is slender, brown, and appears slightly fuzzy. The background consists of out-of-focus green stems and dry beige vegetation.
